## The coordinate planes {#iv2-planes .component-lesson .vector-lesson}

Which coordinate stays zero on each plane?

<div data-components="planes"></div>

<p class="small-note">The shaded patch represents part of a plane that extends indefinitely.</p>

::: notes
Booklet pp. 14–15. Select xy, xz and yz in turn, then vary the missing coordinate to move the point off the plane. The equations are xy: z=0, xz: y=0, yz: x=0. Returning the slider to zero puts the point back on the selected plane. Axes belong to two planes; the origin belongs to all three. Ask students to sketch each plane in their booklet before moving on.
:::
